description:
Shigatsu Makabe comes to the Mouri Detective Agency with a request after malicious flyers began being posted on his own apartment condominium. Kogoro, who was conducting surveillance at the condominium, apprehends a suspicious young man, but... A few days later, a body is found in a unit of a luxury condominium.
Source: crunchyroll

titles.title: Ijiwaru na Otouto ni Komaru Ane
The Sister Troubled by Her Naughty Brother
